before.cases: Raw prefix collisions, non-English labels, literal technical quotations; forged model context/message provenance and title-based suppressed unknown-effect record.

changes: Untyped readback arrays preserve every original line; metadata-label question presentation remains separate.
Runner/model role is supplied by explicit chat methods, never inferred from a line prefix.
Removed English-title compact checkpoint suppression and generated authority/source-effect claims.
Local diff view presents the complete supplied reviewed record; no English field/word filters.
Exact details use generic syntactic styling, not prose validation labels.
retained: Existing privacy disclosure/redaction outside this label formatter
caller_note: Callers needing durable latest-details must use existing rememberDetails explicitly. A matching English title no longer silently retains/compacts a record. No full public caller or UX acceptance claimed.
isolation: slot1, bwrap --unshare-net, owned0700 HOME/TMP, one worker
